messages:
alex: Quick preflight — planning a small kernel-batching toggle in the midnight quiet window (01:30 UTC). This touches router + runtime kernels; API and console should be fine but need pin/unpin coordination. Can runtime do a rolling restart? Any pinned variants we need to hold? @dylan @priya @emma
priya: Runtime ok for rolling restarts, but we have a canary variant pinned in eu-west-1. Recommend leaving that pin until traffic flip completes.
dylan: Router: accepts the kernel tweak. Prefer a gradual traffic flip (10% -> 50% -> 100%). Need deploy-bot to shepherd and a header fallback during canary.
emma: Console: no UI changes, but dashboards will show a latency blip. Please add a mute for ops alerts for ~15m in the runbook.
marcus: SRE checklist: SLA hedge — if p50 > 120ms for 5m OR error-rate > 1% while traffic > 25%, we rollback. Set that as the deploy-bot rollback rule.
alex: Agreed. Rollback criteria: `p50 > 120ms for 5m` OR `error-rate > 1%` when traffic >25%. Also keep a manual hold option.
deploy-bot: deploy initiated by alex at 1723459991. Plan: canary -> staged waves -> full. Canary region: eu-west-1. Canary queued.
helen: Note: this deploy includes a small runtime KV eviction tweak. Runtime, please confirm kv-ttl unchanged.
priya: confirmed — `kv-ttl == 24h` in this build. No config drift.
dylan: Router note: set `header-split.fallback=true` for the canary window. I'll push the header flag before canary start.
alex: I'll put a temporary pin: `router:v2.3.4-pin` for the canary, unpin after 2 successful waves (no thresholds breached). Emma, add a line to release notes: "Router v2.3.4: kernel batching toggle, staged traffic flip; see ops runbook."
priya: runtime pin: `runtime:v1.9.2-patch` pinned in eu-west-1. We'll unpin after 1k successful canary requests.
marcus: I'll monitor metrics in #prod-metrics and be ready to cut traffic. @deploy-bot — call `rollback` if thresholds hit.
deploy-bot: canary started at 1723460100. Running health checks...
deploy-bot: canary results at 1723460120 -> p50=85ms, p95=210ms, errors=0.12% (within thresholds).
dylan: good to go. Start 50% traffic at 1723460180.
deploy-bot: staged wave (50%) started at 1723460180. Monitoring hooks active.
marcus: seeing small tails in us-west but p50 stable. holding the 50% for 5m to validate.
alex: If stable after 10m total, unpin router and runtime. If not stable, rollback to previous kernel and variant.
deploy-bot: staged wave completed at 1723460245. Final state: success. Auto-unpin scheduled at 1723460550 (+5m).
emma: Release notes updated and changelog draft ready. Will post to #release-notes after auto-unpin.
alex: Thanks team — nice coordinated run. :tada:
